public_content.name: Maker General
public_content.description:
A general store built specifically for makers. Maker General
                specializes in thoughtfully selected textile and fiber supplies,
                handmade goods and creative materials. They also host sewing,
                mending and maker workshops.

public_content.name: Boulder County Photography
public_content.story:
Boulder County Photography focuses on the people, relationships and moments that matter. Photographer Michelle Skolyak offers personal portrait sessions that give individuals, couples and families room to feel comfortable and be themselves.

From a senior milestone or engagement to welcoming a new baby or documenting family life, the approach is relaxed and centered on personality and connection. The goal is to create photographs that reflect this chapter of your life.

gallery.alt: Outdoor portrait by Boulder County Photography
gallery.caption: Original portrait photography by Boulder County Photography.

public_content.description: Relaxed portrait and lifestyle photography with Michelle Skolyak, serving Longmont, Boulder County and surrounding Colorado communities.

public_content.name: Tumbleweed Art Collective
public_content.address:
1333 Coffman St., Suite A Longmont, CO
                    80501
public_content.description:
Part boutique, part gallery and part creative community.
                Tumbleweed features handmade art and goods created by local
                artists and makers, including work for the home and garden. It's
                the kind of place where the inventory changes depending on what
                local artists are creating.

public_content.name: Adorn Home & Gift Gallery
public_content.description:
A longtime downtown gift shop filled with home décor, jewelry,
                accessories and unusual gifts. Adorn is a good place to browse
                when you know you need a gift but don't yet know exactly what
                you're looking for.

public_content.name: Magic Fairy Candles
public_content.description:
Much more than a candle shop. Magic Fairy Candles carries
                handmade candles, aromatherapy, crystals, incense, natural
                perfumes, ritual items, apothecary goods and plenty of
                unexpected finds.

public_content.name: Barbed Wire Books
public_content.description:
An independently owned downtown bookstore selling new and used
                books. Browse Colorado and local-interest titles, hard-to-find
                books, maps and guides, plus work from local authors and
                craftspeople.

public_content.name: Cheese Importers
public_content.description:
One of Longmont's true destination specialty stores. Wander
                through a huge selection of international and local cheeses,
                charcuterie, olive oils, spices and specialty foods, then
                explore imported textiles, kitchen goods, soaps, gifts and
                European market finds.

public_content.name: Moroccan Rugs & Gifts
public_content.description:
A specialty shop filled with authentic Moroccan textiles and
                artisan goods. The store is particularly known for Berber and
                tribal rugs, along with leather goods, pillows, ceramics and
                distinctive décor. Definitely one of Longmont's more unexpected
                places to browse.

public_content.name: MKT Visibility
public_content.address: Serving Colorado small businesses Remote services available
public_content.description:
Helping Colorado small businesses stay visible without having to
                do all of the marketing themselves. MKT Visibility provides
                social media management, content creation, photography and
                video, website support, Google Business Profile support, and
                digital marketing services tailored to small businesses.

public_content.name: The Flower Bin
public_content.description:
A family-owned Longmont garden center operating since 1971, with
                five acres of plants, indoor growing space, gardening supplies,
                gifts and home décor.

public_content.name: PopCakes
public_content.description: A family- and woman-owned Longmont bakery creating handmade cakesicles and cake pops in small batches for customers across Northern Colorado.

public_content.name: The Bee Hugger Farm
public_content.description: A quirky six-acre family farm with bees, horses, goats, pigs, chickens, peacocks, U-Pick sunflowers, pumpkins, local honey and more. Visitors can feed animals, climb tractors and explore the property. Check the website and social media for pony rides, storytimes and other special events.

public_content.name: Salt and Bread
public_content.address: Old Town Longmont Pickup details provided with orders
public_content.description: An Old Town Longmont micro-bakery centered on artisan sourdough, baked goods and hands-on sourdough workshops, with preorder-based local pickup.

public_content.name: Crackpots Pottery Studio
public_content.description: A longtime downtown Longmont creative studio where visitors can paint pottery and make art in a relaxed, all-ages setting. Crackpots also hosts parties, group gatherings and creative events.

public_content.name: The Canvas Local Art Bar
public_content.description: A locally owned downtown art studio combining guided painting experiences with an on-site bar featuring Colorado-made drinks and snacks. The Canvas offers classes, open painting and private events.

public_content.name: Wolf & Wren
public_content.story:
Their award-winning cards are designed and printed using vintage
            letterpress equipment, making this a particularly fun stop when
            you're searching for something different.
public_content.description:
One of downtown Longmont's most colorful little shops. Wolf & Wren
            specializes in clever letterpress greeting cards, stationery,
            notebooks, writing tools and thoughtfully curated gifts.

public_content.name: Wax Crescent
public_content.description: Shop small-batch candles and curated artisan goods, or join a candle-making class focused on blending your own fragrance.

public_content.name: Express Employment Professionals
public_content.description: Works with local companies to fill office services, industrial, skilled-trade and other positions throughout Longmont and Boulder County.

public_content.name: Robin Chocolates
public_content.address: 600 S Airport Rd., Building B, Suite D, Longmont, CO 80503
public_content.description: A Longmont chocolate kitchen making bonbons, truffles, bars and seasonal confections with artistic designs and distinctive flavors.

public_content.name: 5280 Staffing Solutions
public_content.description: A regional staffing agency connecting job seekers with light-industrial, skilled-trade, construction, hospitality and other employment opportunities.

public_content.name: Elwood Staffing
public_content.description: Elwood Staffing connects job seekers with temporary, temp-to-hire and permanent opportunities in a variety of industries.

public_content.name: ResourceMFG
public_content.description: A staffing company focused heavily on manufacturing, production and industrial jobs. Search current openings and nearby staffing locations directly through ResourceMFG.

public_content.name: LaborMAX Staffing
public_content.description: A staffing option for people seeking temporary, general labor, construction, warehouse and similar work.

public_content.name: Labor Systems
public_content.description: Another Longmont staffing option for people looking for temporary or labor-oriented opportunities.

public_content.name: ROLINC Staffing & Search
public_content.description: A Colorado-founded staffing and recruiting firm focused on manufacturing, construction, skilled trades, engineering, industrial services and professional positions.

public_content.name: Juniper Goods
public_content.description:
A women-owned lifestyle boutique built around small, independent
                and maker-led brands. Browse apparel, home goods, jewelry,
                ceramics and pantry items, including products from Colorado
                makers. There's also coffee, brunch and a zero-proof bar.

public_content.name: Creative Treasures
public_content.address: 1811 Hover St., Unit C Longmont, CO 80501
public_content.description: A local arts-and-crafts shop combining handmade consignment from Colorado creators with affordable secondhand craft supplies and a classroom for creative gatherings and classes.

public_content.name: Bowen Bakery
public_content.address: Longmont pickup Home bakery — address provided with orders
public_content.description: A Longmont home micro-bakery offering porch pickups, bake stands and custom batches of cookies, cupcakes, muffins, scones, cinnamon rolls, sourdough, cakes and other baked goods.

public_content.name: Golden Loaves
public_content.address: Longmont, Colorado Pickup or local delivery
public_content.description: A Longmont home bakery specializing in small-batch artisan breads, from classic boules and focaccia to flavored loaves, babka and banana bread.

public_content.name: Composition Shop
public_content.description: A community-based independent bookstore in downtown Longmont pairing books with stationery, paper goods and chocolate, plus a busy calendar of book clubs and author events.

public_content.name: The Quill & Candle Bookshop
public_content.description: A cozy independent bookshop in Prospect New Town with curated fiction and children's books, book-themed gifts and community events including author visits and book clubs.

public_content.name: LoCo Skateshop
public_content.description: Founded in Longmont by local skaters, LoCo carries skateboard and longboard gear, clothing and accessories while serving as a community hub for skaters throughout Boulder County.

public_content.name: Absolute Vinyl Records & Stereo
public_content.description: A downtown specialty shop for new and vintage vinyl, 45s and stereo equipment, serving collectors and newer vinyl listeners from its Main Street storefront.

public_content.name: Longmont Bicycle Company
public_content.address: 110 Emery St., Unit D Longmont, CO 80501
public_content.description: A locally owned, family-run full-service bicycle shop founded in 2017, with bikes and e-bikes for many riding styles plus cycling gear, repairs and maintenance.

public_content.name: SNOW Apparel
public_content.address: 520 Main St., Suite B-1 Longmont, CO 80501
public_content.description: An independent downtown women's boutique focused on slow fashion, with clothing and accessories selected around quality, ethical production and sustainable materials.

public_content.name: Ambrosia Glass Art
public_content.description: A Longmont glassblowing studio creating fine glass art and custom work while offering private lessons, two-person workshops and group glassblowing experiences for a range of skill levels.

public_content.name: Simply Bulk Market
public_content.description: A downtown bulk market where shoppers can refill their own containers with foods, spices, teas, personal-care products, cleaning supplies and other goods while reducing packaging waste.

public_content.name: Wheelhouse
public_content.address: 645 Tenacity Dr., Unit E Longmont, CO 80504
public_content.description: A community pottery studio in Prospect New Town focused on adult ceramics education and independent studio practice, with multi-week classes, private events and memberships for experienced potters.

public_content.name: Shoes & Brews
public_content.address: 63 S. Pratt Pkwy., Unit B Longmont, CO 80501
public_content.description: A distinctly Longmont combination of specialty running store and taproom, pairing running shoes and gear with community runs, local beer and a social gathering place for runners and walkers.

public_content.name: Rocky Mountain Pumpkin Ranch
public_content.description: A local seasonal farm destination known for its fall pumpkin activities and family outings.

public_content.name: Wren’s Nest Art Studio
public_content.address: 2030 Ionosphere St., Unit A Longmont, CO
public_content.description: Art classes, camps, open studio sessions and creative gatherings for children and adults.

public_content.name: Quarter’s Bar + Arcade
public_content.description: A locally founded downtown arcade with classic games, pinball, self-serve drinks and private party options.

public_content.name: Butterscotch Studios
public_content.description: A locally owned creative space offering music lessons, arts programming and community collaboration.

public_content.name: Longmont Yarn Shoppe
public_content.description: An independent, woman-owned yarn shop with knitting and crochet supplies, fiber-arts tools and hands-on classes.

public_content.name: Bricks on Main
public_content.description: A downtown destination bringing together locally made products, food, drinks and live entertainment.

public_content.name: Retail Therapy Vendor Market
public_content.description: An indoor multi-vendor market featuring independent sellers, vintage finds and handmade goods.

public_content.name: DirtLabs Suspension
public_content.description: An independent specialist in mountain-bike suspension service, repair and tuning, with local and mail-in service.

public_content.name: NewCastle Comics & Games
public_content.description: A local specialty shop for comic books, tabletop games, trading cards and collectibles.

public_content.name: Drifters
public_content.address: 624 Main St., Suite A Longmont, CO 80501
public_content.description: A downtown vintage clothing shop and cocktail bar offering curated secondhand finds, fresh-juice cocktails, live entertainment and private events.

public_content.name: Longmont Indian Kitchen
public_content.description: Chef Sheel Joshi brings modern Indian cuisine inspired by traditional flavors and refined culinary techniques to an intimate downtown dining room.

public_content.name: The Longmonter Restaurant
public_content.description: A downtown restaurant specializing in gourmet comfort food, including creative seven-cheese macaroni dishes, hearty plates and desserts.

public_content.name: Lobos Cocina & Bar
public_content.description: A locally operated Mexican restaurant with traditional dishes, steaks, seafood, cocktails and a family-friendly sports-viewing atmosphere.

public_content.name: Kawaii Konbini
public_content.address: 195 S Main St., Suite 9 Longmont, CO 80501
public_content.description: A Japanese-inspired neighborhood convenience shop featuring freshly made onigiri, Japanese snacks, drinks, sweets and gifts.

public_content.name: The Blackbird House
public_content.description: A downtown shop for unusual gifts, crystals and metaphysical finds.

public_content.name: Obra Arts
public_content.address: 332 Main St., upstairs on the left, Longmont, CO
public_content.description: Artist Joyanna Rose Gittings welcomes visitors to a working studio and gallery offering handmade art and creative learning in English and Spanish.

public_content.name: Scoops on the Corner
public_content.address: 1844 Hover St., Unit A Longmont, CO 80501
public_content.description: Scoops on the Corner is a locally owned neighborhood ice cream shop in Longmont serving handcrafted ice cream, sundaes, milkshakes, and more. Stop by the shop or take advantage of our convenient drive-thru!

public_content.name: Open Window Studio
public_content.description: Explore art and clay through classes, workshops and camps for children, teens and adults in a creative studio on a Longmont family farm.

public_content.name: Recovery Café Longmont
public_content.description: A community-centered recovery organization creating a welcoming space for people rebuilding their lives. Volunteer opportunities include cooking, hospitality, teaching classes and helping with support activities.
